stored_scale_note: target stored/used as returned by load_Xy (no additional transform on capture)
clip_convention: poisson_deviance: y_pred clipped >= 1e-12 at scoring time (metric_fn); tweedieglm/poissonglm classification-mode mu clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6] at scoring time (run_dataset fold loop); stored arrays are raw, pre-clip
predictions_sha256_scheme: sha256 over arrays in sorted key order; per array: key, NUL, dtype.str, NUL, shape, NUL, C-contiguous data bytes. Hashes array content, not the .npz container, so zip timestamps/compression do not affect it
